ideas.title: Following the Money in Childcare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the use of federal funds in childcare programs and track any changes to funding
questions: How are federal funds being used in childcare programs?
What changes have been made to funding due to allegations of fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger issue with the childcare industry and the need for increased oversight. By following the money, we can track how federal funds are being used and identify any potential issues.
